Anti-Japanese Movement

Picketing groups belonging to Anti-Japanese Boycott Association continued the search for Japanese goods in Chinese controlled territory on January 30 and made the following seizures:-

4.10 p.m.    Heng Feng Road    12 lengths of piece goods
                                8 lengths of imitation
                                venetian.

4.40 p.m.    Jukong Road       a bale of wall paper
                                1 packet of salted fish
                                1 packet of biche de mer.

The above-mentioned seizures are detained in the Anti-Japanese Boycott Inspectors' Office at No. 15 Tien Chi Li, Paoshan Road Chapei.

Chung Feng Lai, manager and shareholder of the Yueh Lai Dry Goods Store at No. 1151-4 Canton Road, who was arrested on January 13, on a charge of being a traitorous merchant was released on the morning of January 30, 1929, upon the payment of a fine of $10,000.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Labour

The strike situation in the Sun Sun Co., No.145 Nanking Road, remains unchanged. Some 20 members of the Strike Committee held a meeting between 5 and 6.30 p.m. January 30, 1929, in the offices of their Union at No.7 Kung Yih Li, Off North Thibet Road, O.O.L., when the following resolutions were discussed and passed:-

1. That preparations be made to celebrate on February 1 the enforcement of the Customs autonomy.
2. That further representations be made to the Management of the Company for the issue of wages due.
3. That a general meeting of strikers be held on February 1, 1929 at a place to be fixed later.

548 female workers of H.W.K.No.7 Mill, 14 West Soochow Road, are on strike to-day as a result of the management cutting the wages of workers who operate one machine only with a view to bettering the wages of the more efficient hands who operate several machines, on the decision of the Management being announced at 7.30 a.m. January 20, operatives in the Weaving Department promptly struck work and submitted the following demands:-

1. That the wages be paid according to the current rate during the year 1927.
2. That all employees only work 2 machines.
3. That the Company pay an extra $3.00 for the second half of January .

The management in reply made the following counter-proposals:-

1. That the Company pay according to the current rate during the first half of January 1929.
2. That the Company will allow the employees to leave work at 5 p.m.
3. That the company will not request the workers to work 5 machines.

情报报告。
劳工

南京路145号“新新公司”的罢工局势保持不变。1929年1月30日下午5时至6时30分，约20名罢工委员会成员在北西藏路公义里7号（O.O.L.）的工会办事处举行会议，讨论并通过以下决议：-

1. 准备于2月1日庆祝关税自主实施。
2. 进一步向公司管理层交涉，要求发放拖欠工资。
3. 定于1929年2月1日举行罢工工人大会，地点待定。

西苏州路14号华生织造厂第七厂（H.W.K. No.7 Mill）的548名女工今日罢工，原因是管理层宣布决定，旨在提高操作多台机器的高效工人的工资，而削减仅操作一台机器的工人的工资。该决定于1月20日上午7时30分公布后，织布部工人立即停工，并提出以下要求：-

1. 按照1927年的现行费率支付工资。
2. 所有员工每人仅操作2台机器。
3. 公司额外支付1月份下半月工资3.00美元。

管理层回复提出以下反建议：-

1. 公司按照1929年1月上半月的现行费率支付工资。
2. 公司允许员工于下午5时下班。
3. 公司不要求工人操作5台机器。

At 6 p.m. the nightshift workers submitted the same three demands as made by the day shift workers, and in the mill compound indulged in window smashing. Police attended the mob was quietened and left the premises at 7.45 p.m.

This morning some 300 of the strikers are congregated on North Chekiang Road near the entrance to the Provisional Court to lodge a protest with the President of the Court against the decision of the Management. So far the crowd has been orderly and extra police have been detailed to prevent rowdyism. These people have never dispersed & form of their number will tomorrow submit to the President of the Pub. Court a petition containing their grievances.

The employees of the S.N.R. and the S.H.N.R, have submitted to their managements a request for an increase of wages as under:-

| :--- | :--- |
| Under $20 per month | 45% |

| " $51 to $100 " | 30% |

The administration is making provision to grant a general increase equivalent to 8% of present wages of all employees.

3. That Sundays be observed as holidays and that employees working on Sundays be given double wages.
4. That usual wages plus medical expenses be given to employees on sick leave.
5. That various festival days be observed as holidays.

下午6时，夜班工人提出了与白班工人相同的三项要求，并在厂区院内参与砸窗行为。警察到场后平息了骚乱，人群于晚上7时45分离开现场。

今天上午，约300名罢工者聚集在浙江北路临时法院入口附近，向法院院长抗议管理层的决定。目前人群秩序井然，已增派警力防止滋事。这些人尚未散去，他们中的代表将于明天向公共租界法院院长提交一份包含其诉求的请愿书。

上海电车公司（S.N.R.）和上海北四川路电车公司（S.H.N.R.）的员工已向各自管理层提交加薪请求，具体如下：-

| 现有工资 | 要求增幅 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 每月低于20美元 | 45% |
| 每月21至50美元 | 35% |
| " 51至100美元 " | 30% |
| " 101至150美元 " | 25% |
| " 150美元以上 " | 20% |

资方正打算给予普遍加薪，幅度相当于所有员工现有工资的8%。

本地粤菜馆员工最近向雇主提出以下要求：-

1. 增加工资
2. 从每100美元“小费”收入中拨出8美元，汇交员工工会。
3. 星期日定为假日，星期日工作的员工发给双倍工资。
4. 病假员工发给正常工资及医疗费。
5. 各种节日定为假日。

应员工请求，上海市政府社会局目前正在调解此纠纷。

TRANSLATION OF EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORTS.

January 31, 1929.

The trouble at Langkow, Shantung Province, is spreading
more and more. Liu Kai Tai, leader of the revolting troops
(bandits) is preparing to attack the neighbouring magistracies.

The military police of the 9th Company of the 3rd
Battalion of the 1st Regiment at Hangchow left for Nanking at
10 a.m. yesterday. The military police of the 8th Company of
the 3rd Battalion at Nanking will replace them at Hangchow.

1929年1月31日。

山东省兰考（Langkow，音译）的动乱日益蔓延。叛军（匪徒）首领刘开泰正准备攻击邻近的县署。

杭州第一团第三营第九连的宪兵于昨日上午10时前往南京。南京第三营第八连的宪兵将接替他们在杭州的防务。

S.M.P., C.I.D. CRIME REPORT.                                      Pootoo Road      Police Station.
                                                                                   Record No.
Further report on strike at N.W.K.No.7 Mill.

CONTINUATION           From further enquiries made re the strike at the
SHEET                  N.W.K.No7 mill, it was ascertained that the day shift
                       went on strike again at 6 a.m. 31.1.29.
                       At about 6.25 a.m. the employees started to take
                       a threatening attitude and at about 7 a.m. were escorted
                       from the mill compound by the police at the request of
                       the mill manager, Mr. Nakzawa, as he feared that serious
                       damage might be done.
                       Information was received by the detectives that
                       the mill workers were going to the Provisional Court to
                       lodge their complaint there. At 9:40 a.m. a telephone
                       message was received from the Provisional Court that about
                       400 workers were outside.
                       The mill management are locking out all the workers
                       at No. 7 mill tonight and a poster to that effect has
                       been posted at the gate of the mill.
                       West Hongkew and the Provisional Court were
                       informed re the above.

                                          Your obedient servant,
                                          C. E. Brownlow
                                          P.C.P.S. 195.

                                                                   （批：jr）

                                                                                   记录编号。
关于西北织造厂第七厂罢工的后续报告。

续页           经对西北织造厂第七厂罢工进行进一步调查，查明
               白班工人于1929年1月31日上午6时再次罢工。
               约上午6时25分，员工开始采取威胁性姿态，约上午7时，
               应工厂经理中泽（Nakzawa，音译）先生的请求，由警察
               护送出厂区，因为他担心可能会造成严重破坏。
               侦探收到情报称，工厂工人将前往临时法院投诉。
               上午9时40分，接到临时法院电话消息，称约有
               400名工人在院外。
               工厂管理层今晚将对第七厂所有工人实行闭厂，
               并在工厂大门张贴了相应告示。
               虹口西区及临时法院已获知上述情况。

                                          您顺从的仆人，
                                          C. E. Brownlow
                                          警长编号 195。

                                                                   （批注：jr）

助理警务处长（政治）。
